comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. Bear Mountain (way/682224991, named Big Bear Mountain Resort in OpenStreetMap) on its own map (owner decision 2026-10-29); the mountain also draws on the combined big-bear-mountain-resort map with Snow Summit. The entries are the Bear Mountain ones of big-bear-mountain-resort.overrides.json, checked on 2026-10-21 against the resort's Bear Mountain trail map (bigbearmountainresort.com, 2500 x 1770 v2, read at full resolution); ratings follow the map, also where OpenStreetMap rates a run one step harder (Showtime). Named parks get the park flag, as at Mammoth: the map marks them as freestyle terrain. Lift names stay plain (Chair 3, Chair 4, Chair 7, Chair 8, MC1 to MC4): the combined map prefixes the names both mountains share with the mountain's name, which a map of one mountain does not need (owner decision 2026-10-29). Snow Summit and Big Bear Snow Play are left off through resorts.json's neighbours, their lifts and runs with them; Magic Mountain's chair and carpet, in the Overpass margin west of the box, are hidden here, as its sled polygon has no name to list (lead's decision 2026-10-22).

overrides.reason: Alpine Slide at Magic Mountain's chair, a separate business 5 km west of Bear Mountain (summer alpine slide and snow tubing), not a lift of this resort; its only polygon is an unnamed sledding area. It lies in the Overpass margin west of the box, where it would otherwise draw as a lift in the z10-11 edge tiles.
Alpine Slide at Magic Mountain's snow-tubing carpet, a separate business, not a lift of this resort; in the Overpass margin west of the box, as its chair.
Gambler is a single black diamond on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2) (two labels); OSM rates it intermediate.
Showtime is a single black diamond on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2); OSM rates it expert.
Terrain park without a park tag in OSM: Amusement Park carries the freestyle-terrain symbol on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2).
Terrain park without a park tag in OSM: Central Park carries freestyle-terrain symbols on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2).
Terrain park without a park tag in OSM: Park Run (Upper) and (Face) carry freestyle-terrain symbols on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2).

The lower part of Park Run: the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2) labels it PARK RUN (LOWER), with a freestyle-terrain symbol. OSM's 'The Park Run' splits the run's name in two and has no park tag.
